name: The Future Is Loading...
storyline:
Congrats, you're a grad!… Now what?

You and your friend have just graduated, but you have no sense of direction and no future plans. You’re worried about what the future will hold and feel a need to find out what you’re supposed to be doing with your life. Luckily though, your friend has an app on their phone that has all the answers, all you have to do is answer a few questions truthfully…

The future is loading… Are you ready for it?
summary: A game about an all-knowing phone app and soon-to-be graduates.
